howTo.name: How to research NFL player props with WagerProof
howTo.description: A four-step weekly workflow for moving from the full NFL slate to a short list of props worth reviewing.

steps.name: Build an NFL props Agent
steps.text: Select NFL, allow player props, emphasize props, and set the confidence, risk, pick-volume, and parlay preferences that match the way you research.

steps.name: Start with the strongest signals
steps.text: Open Outliers and Props, filter the slate, and use recent hit-rate signals to create a short list instead of reading every available market.

steps.name: Review parlay combinations
steps.text: Use Parlay God to inspect combinations assembled from legs on perfect tracked streaks, then review each leg on its own merits.

steps.name: Verify the player trend page
steps.text: Open each player to compare the current line, alternate lines, L10 results, streaks, matchup history, and situational splits before making a decision.

faqs.question: What is the fastest way to find NFL player props in 2026?
faqs.answer: Use a WagerProof Agent focused on NFL player props to narrow the slate, scan the Props and Outliers signals, then verify each candidate on its individual player trend page.

faqs.question: Can a WagerProof Agent specialize in NFL player props?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agent setup lets you select NFL, allow player props, emphasize that market, control daily pick volume, skip weak slates, and adjust confidence, risk, and parlay preferences.

faqs.question: Does a perfect recent streak mean the next prop will hit?
faqs.answer: No. A streak describes the tracked sample at a particular line. The next result can still lose, and a different line, role, opponent, or price can change the question.
